statement: Exactly one equilibrium for every J in [0, 200] and every E_l in [10.59, 10.62].
The equilibrium is asymptotically stable for J < J_H1 and for J > J_H2, and has exactly two eigenvalues with positive real part strictly between the Hopf points.
At J = 8, for every E_l in [10.59, 10.62], an orbitally asymptotically stable periodic orbit with period in [16.005827509, 16.013912063] ms.
Du and Hassard (2001) was not read beyond the first page.
Rinzel and Miller (1980) was not obtained.
